title: Patty Ann Charters
specs: Captain Greg Gargiulo is a two-time New York State and IGFA Record Holder
Boat equipped with GPS, VHF radio, fish finder, radar, life raft, survival gear, fighting chair, ice-box, live bait tank, outriggers
Boat capacity up to six passengers max
blurb: Guests fish for various species including Mahi Mahi, Bluefin Tuna, Yellowfin Tuna, Swordfish, White Marlin, Tautog, Black Seabass, Flounder, Striped Bass, Bluefish, Mako Shark, and Thresher Shark. Trips range from 4 hours to overnight excursions. The boat is a 35-ft downeast vessel equipped with fishing gear, tackle, licenses, and fish cleaning included.
extraNote: Deposits are non refundable · Cancellation 7 days before trip are non refundable · All trips canceled due to weather or captains choice not to go must be rebooked within 12 calendar months · Captree State Park in Babylon, New York
